PRESS MEMO 


THE UNIVERSITY 1S PARTICULARLY PLEASED TO HAVE 
ITS WORK IN MODERN HEBREW LANGUAGE AND IN HEBREW 
CULTURE STUDIES ACKNOWLEDGED AND ENHANCED BY 
THIS PRESENTATION TO THE LIBRARY. 


S1R GEORGE 1S THE ONLY UNIVERSITY IN EASTERN 
CANADA OFFERING COURSES IN MODERN HEBREW, THE 
LANGUAGE OF THE NEW STATE OF ISRAEL. SIMILAR
